messages.author: f17a14a297957cec
messages.subject: shiny js files
parts:
In shiny index.html, need to include the following lines

<script src="shared/jquery.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
 <script src="shared/shiny.js" type="text/javascript"></script>

But I was wondering where this files are located and how to get those files?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: shiny js files
parts:
They are here:

system.file('www', 'shared', package = 'shiny')

You can also find them in the Github repo:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/tree/master/inst/www/shared (the
development versions)

Regards,
Yihui
